title: Lobby
note: The ship is the lobby (the target page pages/suit-final, frames 1, 3 and 3b): the game boots into the aliens' ship and the player walks around it; the HUD over the world is thin and calm. The mouse is captured and every HUD node has mouse_filter IGNORE. In a session the HUD is the ready count at the top centre, the roster at the top right (the host mark and a ready pip per player), the own ready state and the mic at the bottom left. Ready toggles on the bound ready key (control.ready, rebindable in Settings › Controls). The countdown starts when everyone is ready and the mode's demands are met; an un-ready stops it. The match settings are no tab of the Esc menu: they are a screen on the ship's console (Console below), a SubViewport scene as the workbench s11 is, shown on the console's mesh to whoever stands near it; the host edits it with the crosshair, everyone else reads it. How the trip maps onto Lobby, Countdown, Loading and Pregame is open (the engineer's design).

states.label: Старт
states.note: The game has just loaded into the ship with no session: no HUD but a small hint at the bottom left (the target's frame 1). Esc opens the suit menu (s5 ship), where the player hosts or joins.

states.label: Очікування
states.note: A code joiner's view (Zinga) in a lobby of six: four ready, the own player among them. The two players in sight carry their name plates.

states.label: Відлік
states.note: Everyone ready and the mode's demands met: the countdown runs 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 in the same plate, every pip full.

states.label: Замало гравців
states.note: Fewer players than the mode needs: the plate says how many more, instead of the ready count, and its pips hide. The own player not ready.

states.label: Пульт: хост
states.note: The host (Olena) at the console (the target's frame 3b): the console's screen, the SubViewport scene Console, drawn at its 960 x 540 where the player looks, with the HUD over the world. The crosshair is on the lower right of the humans' minus, clear of its icon, so the button hovers (pushed mouse motion, as in s11).

states.label: Пульт: гравець
states.note: Another player (Zinga) reading the console: the same screen without steppers or choices, values only, and the lock line naming the host.

nodes.name: Plates
nodes.note: The name plate layer (P6, #257), the same as s7/Plates, under the rest of the HUD: one Plate per other player in line of sight within about 10 m. Code: position = camera.unproject_position(head + 0.35 m), the plate centred on it; hidden behind walls (raycast), beyond 10 m or behind the camera. No role, no health. Not drawn in the console frames, where the screen fills the view.

children.name: Glorp
children.note: One instance per visible player, moved every frame to the projected point (the samples stand over two players, as on the target). The teammate mark of s7 never shows here: roles do not exist yet in the lobby.

children.name: Name
children.note: The player's name from code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); no translated text.

nodes.name: Console
nodes.note: Not a HUD node: the console's own scene, the root of a SubViewport (960 x 540, the target's 640 x 360 x 1.5, with the game's Theme) whose ViewportTexture the ship console's screen mesh shows, built as s11 is (anchors full_rect in the viewport). Whoever stands near the console sees the same screen; the host works it with the crosshair (the game raycasts the screen mesh and pushes the hit point into the SubViewport as mouse motion and Interact as a left click, SubViewport.push_input), so the control under the crosshair hovers. The page draws the canvas at its own size where the player looks (moved so the crosshair falls on the lower right of the humans' minus, clear of its icon), under the HUD. Every change applies live for everyone. There are no presets (the target has none, agent); the lobby name field and Knives are not on it (open).

children.name: Title
children.note: The console's title, as the target's «Матч» (console.title, the engineer's word, 2026-10-22): the console sets up the match. The lobby's own name (#214) is not on the console; it is what the suit menu's lobbies nearby list shows (s5).

children.name: HostNote
children.note: At most 420 wide, so the title keeps its room; a long translation wraps to two lines.

children.name: HostOnly
children.note: Everyone but the host: the lock and who changes the settings.

children.name: Rows
children.note: The MVP match settings of frame 7 of pages/mvp-screens, moved here from the Esc menu's Lobby tab: the humans, the anger threshold, the match length, the Wi-Fi passwords. Rows at least 72 px (four rows and the code fit the 456 px inside the frame; the target's three rows are 96), the controls right-aligned, every value 156 px wide so the arrows line up. The host sees the steppers and the choice; everyone else the values only.

children.name: Humans
children.note: The exact number of humans among the players (m8 §2, #1032). Bounds and the default per player count are open.

children.name: Less
children.note: Steps the value down; disabled (unplugged) at the lower bound. Under the crosshair in console-host, so it hovers. Every stepper here works the same; a player who is not the host sees only the value.

children.name: Value
children.note: {count} the humans set; {total} the players now in the lobby, also the stepper's maximum, so it follows joins and leaves.

children.name: More
children.note: Steps the value up; disabled at the upper bound.

children.name: Anger
children.note: The neighbours' anger threshold that calls the cops (m8 §5).

children.name: Choice
children.note: One ButtonGroup of two toggles that touch (the target's .seg): a Control with the two halves placed side by side by anchors, since a box's smallest gap is 4 px. Each label is the number (data, auto_translate_mode DISABLED). The choices are open (the engineer's design); 50 and 100 are the sketch's samples.

children.name: Value
children.note: A player who is not the host sees the chosen threshold only: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), in the steppers' value column.

children.name: WifiPasswords
children.note: The Wi-Fi task's N: the passwords to enter before the task is done (GDD §8). Bounds and the default are the game's data.

children.name: Value
children.note: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: Code
children.note: The room code at the screen's foot (the target's .vft), for everyone near the console to read out: the host who hosted with a code and every player who joined with it. Hidden in a Direct session (LAN or VPN: no code exists). There is no Copy here (the crosshair is no clipboard); copying the code is the Esc menu's (s5).

children.name: Value
children.note: The room code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); "…" while the code service has not made the room yet (JoinProgress.CODE_WAITING). When the service is gone, the row shows esc.lobby.code_gone in ToyTextMutedOnLight instead.

nodes.name: Cross
nodes.note: The crosshair (P5), centred on the screen (its size is the variation's); over the console it is what the host points with. Not drawn at the boot (the target's frame 1 has no UI but the hint).

nodes.name: Status
nodes.note: The ready plate (the target's .wait): the count at the left, one pip per player at the right, the ready ones full and first. 360 x 66 (the target's 240 x 44 x 1.5).

children.name: Text
children.note: lobby.waiting {count} ready of {total} players; lobby.need_more (tr_n) while the lobby has fewer players than the mode needs (other unmet demands of #208 take their own keys later); during the countdown lobby.countdown, once a second from 5 to 1, in the same calm text (agent).

children.name: Pips
children.note: One pip per player in the lobby (up to 10): ToyPipHealth for each ready player, ToyPip for the rest (the suit's pips). Hidden while the plate says how many more players are needed.

nodes.name: Players
nodes.note: The roster as in the round (s7/Roster), with a ready pip per row. Rebuilt when a player joins, leaves, renames or toggles ready. 330 px wide (the target's 184 x 1.5 = 276, widened so «Олена · хост» fits at large text); a long name is cut with an ellipsis.

children.name: Head
children.note: Players in the lobby / the lobby's limit, the tile's head (the target's .tab «ГРАВЦІ 6 / 10»; the game sets uppercase = true).

children.name: Name
children.note: One row per player in join order, the host first: the body colour, the name, the host tag on the host's row, the ready pip. Names are user text (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: NameSelf
children.note: The own row reads hud.roster.self in the accent, as in the round: the host's own view (console-host) reads «Олена (ти)». In the game one Label swaps key and variation.

children.name: HostTag
children.note: The host tag (the target's quiet «ХОСТ»; hud.roster.host, the engineer's copy round 9), on the host's row only.

children.name: Ready
children.note: ToyPipHealth while that player is ready, ToyPip while not.

children.name: Hint
children.note: The only UI at the boot (the target's frame 1): the key that opens the suit menu. Hidden once a session starts. Its word is tutorial.list.menu, the controls list's «Меню» (the target's draft is «меню»).

children.name: Text
children.note: The bound key's label (ui_cancel, auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: Ready
children.note: The own ready state (the target's .rdy): a calm tile with the ready pip and the words, ToyPipHealth with lobby.ready_yes while ready, ToyPip with lobby.ready_no while not.

children.name: Mic
children.note: The mic (P4): mic.svg in icon_on while anybody can hear the player, mic-off.svg in icon_off when nobody does. The target's lobby frame has no mic; it stays beside the ready tile (agent).
